guide.title: Free 4 Day Shanghai Itinerary
guide.description:
Welcome :) I made you all a little Shanghai itinerary!
This is a basic itinerary that includes the popular “must-see” attractions.
I understand that everyone has di ff erent activities they’re interested in doing and
di ff erent things they want to experience when traveling to a new country (food,
sightseeing, nightlife, shopping, pet cafes, technology, photoshoots, tattoos,
aesthetics, beauty, museums, city, nature, history, etc)
If you are interested in a more detailed and personalized itinerary, check out the
GOLD and PLATINUM plans. I’d be happy to create an itinerary tailored to your
interests and needs, with more local businesses and services I can connect you
with.
Enjoy, China is waiting for you ;)

data.name: Street
data.description: Nan Jing Lu Bu Xing Jie, Huang Pu Qu, Shang Hai Shi, China Shanghai’s most iconic commercial street and a must-visit for travelers who want to experience the city’s vibrant energy. Stretching over 5 kilometers, it links the Bund in the east with Jing’an Temple in the west, o ff ering everything from luxury boutiques to traditional snacks. You can  fi nd China's largest Popmart store here. Tips - Be prepared for large crowds - Anime lovers you will  fi nd a 7 story anime mall - Time to spend: 2-3 hrs � � � �  (Dōng Fāng Míng Zhū) Oriental Pearl

data.name: Tower
data.description: One of Shanghai’s most famous landmarks, standing 468 meters tall in Pudong. It has observation decks, a glass- bottomed walkway, and a revolving restaurant with amazing city views. At night, it glows with colorful lights and shines as a symbol of modern Shanghai. Tips - Tower open time: 9am - 9pm - Ticket price ranges from 199 - 299 RMB - Consider coming at night for night view - Light schedule: May - Sept: 7pm lights on, 11pm lights o ff  Oct - Apr: 6pm lights on, 10 pm lights o ff  - Time to spend: ~1 hr
data.address: 1 Shiji Blvd, Lujiazui, Pudong, Shanghai, China, 200120

data.name: � �  (Wài Tān) The Bund
data.description: Shanghai’s famous waterfront, known for its historic colonial- era buildings along the Huangpu River. Visitors can stroll the promenade, enjoy river views, and admire the contrast between the old architecture and modern Pudong skyline. At night, the glowing skyline across the river makes it one of the city’s most iconic sights. Tips - Day and night are two di ff erent vibes - Light schedule: May - Sept: 7pm lights on, 11pm lights o ff  Oct - Apr: 6pm lights on, 10 pm lights o ff  - Time to spend: ~1 hr - Lots of bars along The Bund for amazing drinks and night view

data.name: � � �  (Tián Zǐ Fǎng) Tianzifang
data.description: Tianzifang is a lively arts and crafts area in Shanghai’s French Concession, built within traditional shikumen alleyways. Visitors can explore art studios, boutique shops, cafes, and bars while enjoying its creative, bohemian atmosphere. It’s a perfect spot to experience Shanghai’s mix of history, culture, and modern art. Tips - A lot of stores with street food and snacks to try - Cute stores to buy souvenirs - Artistic and cultural street to take lots of pictures - Time to spend: ~2 hrs

data.name: � � �  (Sī Nán Lù) Sinan Road
data.description: Si Nan Lu, Huang Pu Qu, Shang Hai Shi, China Sinan Road is a quiet, tree-lined street in Shanghai’s French Concession, known for its preserved European-style buildings. Visitors can stroll past boutique shops, cafes, and historic mansions while enjoying the peaceful atmosphere. It’s a perfect spot to experience Shanghai’s mix of history and modern lifestyle. Tips - Visit the Sinan Mansion - Visit the Sinan bookstore - There are small museums on this street - Time to spend: 1-2 hrs

data.name: � �  (Yù Yuán) Yu Garden
data.description: Classical Chinese garden in Shanghai’s Old City, famous for its pavilions, ponds, rockeries, and winding paths. Visitors can enjoy the peaceful landscaping and traditional architecture while exploring the lively surrounding Yuyuan Bazaar. It’s a perfect spot to experience Shanghai’s history, culture, and scenic beauty. Tips - Open time: Tues - Sun: 9am - 4pm - Ticket: 30 RMB - Time to spend: ~1 hr
data.address: 279 Yu Yuan Lao Jie,  � � �  Huangpu, Shanghai, China, 200000

data.name: � � �  (Chéng Huáng Miào) City God Temple
data.description: Famous Taoist temple in Shanghai’s Old City, dedicated to the City God who protects the city. Visitors can admire its traditional architecture and then explore the lively surrounding bazaar  fi lled with shops and local snacks. It’s both a cultural and spiritual landmark of Shanghai. Tips - Come at night for the beautiful lights - Ticket: 10 RMB - Time to spend: 2-3 hrs
data.address: 427 � � � � � �  Fu You Lu,  � � �  Huang Pu Qu, Shang Hai Shi, China, 200010

data.name: � � �  (Wǔ Kāng Lù) Wu Kang Road
data.description: A charming street in Shanghai’s French Concession, lined with historic villas, co ff ee shops, and leafy trees. Many former homes of writers and artists still stand, making it a popular spot for walking and photography. Tips - You will see the Wukang building landmark, where everyone takes pictures in front of it - Many spots to take cute pictures - Many co ff ee shops and cute restaurants - Time to spend: 1-2 hrs
data.address: Wu Kang Lu, Xu Hui Qu, Shang Hai Shi, China, 200031

data.name: � � �  (Ān Fú Lù) Anfu Road
data.description: A stylish street in Shanghai’s French Concession, lined with boutiques, cafés, bakeries, and art spaces. Its leafy trees and relaxed atmosphere make it a favorite spot for walking, shopping, and enjoying modern café culture. It’s especially popular with young locals and visitors looking for a trendy vibe. Tips - A lot of cute stores on this street - Time to spend: 1-2 hrs
data.address: An Fu Lu, Xu Hui Qu, Shang Hai Shi, China, 200031

data.name: � � �  (Jìng Ān Sì) Jing An Temple
data.description: Historic Buddhist temple in central Shanghai, known for its golden roofs and tranquil atmosphere amid the bustling city. Tips - Open: 7:30am - 5:00pm - Ticket: 50 RMB - Time to spend: ~1 hr
data.address: 1661 Nan Jing Xi Lu,  � � �  Jing An Qu, Shang Hai Shi, China, 200041

data.name: � � � �  (Huái Hǎi Zhōng Lù) Huaihai Road
data.description: Huai Hai Zhong Lu, Xu Hui Qu, Shang Hai Shi, China A famous shopping street in Shanghai’s French Concession, known for its plane trees, luxury boutiques, and cosmopolitan charm. Tips Stores to check out: - HAUS NOWHERE - TX Youth Energy Center - niko and... - MASONPRINCE - MINISO - iapm - FARMER BOB Time to spend: 2-3 hrs

data.name: � � �  (Xīn Tiān Dì) Xintiandi
data.description: A lively district in Shanghai’s French Concession, famous for its restored shikumen houses that combine traditional charm with modern style. The area is  fi lled with restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques, making it a hotspot for dining and nightlife. It’s the perfect place to experience Shanghai’s blend of history and modern lifestyle. Tips - Several malls surrounding the area - Lots of restaurants and bars in the area - Time to spend: 2-3 hrs

data.name: Disneyland
data.description: Shanghai Disneyland is a magical theme park in Pudong, featuring the world’s largest Disney castle and themed lands like Adventure Isle and Tomorrowland. Visitors can enjoy rides, shows, parades, and unique Disney experiences with a blend of Chinese cultural elements. The resort also includes hotels, dining, and shopping, making it a perfect destination for families and Disney fans.
